mapper.sql: id, tenant_id, name, username, mobile, avatar_url, password_hash, status, force_password_change, role_id, department_id
mapper.select: SELECT FROM chengke_crm.sys_user WHERE lower(username) = lower(#{username})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chengke_crm.auth_login_failure (account_key, fail_count, window_started_at, locked_until) VALUES (#{accountKey}, #{failCount}, #{windowStartedAt}, #{lockedUntil}) ON CONFLICT (account_key) DO UPDATE SET fail_count = EXCLUDED.fail_count, window_started_at = EXCLUDED.window_started_at, locked_until = EXCLUDED.locked_until
INSERT INTO chengke_crm.auth_captcha (token, code_hash, expires_at) VALUES (#{token}, #{codeHash}, #{expiresAt})
INSERT INTO chengke_crm.auth_session (id, tenant_id, user_id, remember_me, expires_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{tenantId}, #{userId}, #{rememberMe}, #{expiresAt})
